steps.title: 1. Open
steps.body: Choose a save and an identity file. The original save remains read-only.

steps.title: 2. Choose a slot
steps.body: Check whether a slot is used or empty, then choose the edit target. Empty slots are not written.

steps.title: 3. Edit
steps.body: Change only fields exposed by the Pack and stay within the displayed allowed range.

steps.title: 4. Back up
steps.body: A verified backup is created before a file is written.

steps.title: 5. Validate
steps.body: Review changes and validation. Writing stops when a required safety condition is missing.

steps.title: 6. Export
steps.body: After review, export a new file. The original save is not overwritten.

steps.title: Simple / Advanced
steps.body: These modes present the same data for different needs. Switching modes does not discard changes.

steps.title: Search
steps.body: Find currently available fields by label, description, or Pack-supplied keyword.

steps.title: Favorites
steps.body: Save local references to frequently used fields. The Pack and save are not modified.

steps.title: Slots
steps.body: Review each slot state and its pending-change count. Common data is tracked separately.

steps.title: Backup and restore
steps.body: A restored backup is also saved as a new file.

steps.title: Validation
steps.body: Declared constraints and integrity rules are checked, and invalid writes are rejected.

steps.title: Compatibility Pack
steps.body: Compatibility data is added as signed declarative data. Packs contain no executable code.

steps.title: Offset
steps.body: The location of a value inside a save.

steps.title: Endian
steps.body: The byte order used for a multi-byte value.

steps.title: Checksum
steps.body: A value used to check data integrity.

steps.title: Runtime Cheat
steps.body: This means changing a running game's memory. It is separate from save editing and is not a current feature.

steps.title: Pack
steps.body: Declarative, non-executable data containing game-specific information.

steps.title: Trust
steps.body: The boundary that verifies signatures, hashes, and compatibility and rejects untrusted Packs.

steps.title: Capability
steps.body: A feature contract explicitly supported by Core. Unknown required capabilities are rejected.
